article.title: Грецкие орехи и вспышка E. coli: что показали пробы и прослеживаемость
article.scope: Полный перевод основной статьи на 2 журнальных страницах: краткое содержание, весь текст расследования, 1 рисунок с подписью, благодарности, сведения об авторах и организациях, заявление о конфликте интересов и все 3 сноски. Все 5 библиографических записей сохранены на языке оригинала. График воспроизведён без изменения данных; перевод надписей приведён под ним. Текст подготовлен по полному XML PMC и сверён с PDF издателя. Редакционные пояснения отделены от перевода.

source.license: Public domain, confirmed by article-specific PMC XML and MMWR policy
source.rights_note: Full attribution, free-source link and nonendorsement notice supplied. Publisher PDF and figure bytes preserved. Translation and editorial explanations identified separately; no CDC logo introduced.
source.status_check: Crossref has no update-to relation; XML has no retracted-article relation; PubMed and targeted DOI correction search revealed no correction or retraction of this report.

selection.reader: Quality, food safety, HACCP, laboratory and technology staff working with tree nuts.
selection.utility: Combines epidemiology and batch traceback with a household Shiga-toxin-gene PCR finding and negative supplier product/environmental samples.
selection.limits: Historical US outbreak closed June 25, 2024; source published November 27, 2025. Eleven interviewed of 13 cases; eight traced stores of nine. One household sample positive for a Shiga-toxin gene does not establish isolation of a viable outbreak strain. Contamination route unknown. No organic-versus-conventional risk comparison or market prevalence estimate.

review.spelled_numbers: Full comparison: seven initial infections; three-allele case criterion; 13 cases = seven California plus six Washington; seven hospitalized, two HUS; 11 interviewed, ten bulk purchases; four household samples (two per state), one Shiga-toxin-gene positive; nine stores, eight linked to two lots and one grower; two product plus 11 environmental samples negative. Figure bars sum to 13 and dates agree with case window.
review.pdf_visual_review: All five pages inspected; original graph with translated labels, separate editorial notes, all source text and attribution retained.

typesafe.mode: additional review for coverage; full source review retained
typesafe.result: preserved in all four; deliberately overstated negative control correctly flagged
typesafe.scope: Case definition, PCR versus isolation, traceback denominators, uncertainty about prevention and contamination route; no automatic acceptance or efficiency claim.
